findings.evidence: Round-3 DOWNGRADE: this is a spec-methodology defect, not a code defect. OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:53 filters `whereIn('status', [OrderStatus::PREPARING, OrderStatus::PREPARED])` — OSS by design does NOT display orders in status PAID (4). Wave D state07 captures OSS RIGHT AFTER pay (status=4 PAID); the new POS-paid order N°A0175 (id=750) cannot appear in OSS at this point because OSS only renders PREPARING+PREPARED. Round-3 evidence: state07 DOM grep 'A0175' → 0 matches; state10 (post-KDS-IN_PROGRESS, status=PREPARING) DOM grep 'A0175' → MATCH; state13 (post-KDS-READY, status=PREPARED) DOM grep 'A0175' → MATCH; state16 (post-served, status=DELIVERED) DOM grep 'A0175' → 0 matches. OSS pickup works AS DESIGNED — picks up at status transition into PREPARING (latency_ms=8 at state13 ossReady=true). The 14.6s 'budget miss' at state07 is the spec asserting on the wrong status window. Listener-ordering fix (PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox first) cannot help because OSS doesn't query PAID orders. Reclassifying D-002 from 'silent_error P0 = code broken' to 'audit_integrity P2 = spec asserts on wrong status window'.
findings.fix_hint: Spec fix: state07 budget assertion should target status==PAID visibility on POS tracker (which works — state09 reflects IN_PROGRESS), NOT OSS pickup. OSS pickup should be measured AT KDS-marks-IN_PROGRESS transition (state10 vs state08 timing — already measured separately at sync_oss_ready_ms=8ms).
